comment: The 19 leaders.json boxes whose next leader is Brawly, at 20 seeds: the set for measuring early-catch counterfactuals (--swap-catch) against the first gym wall. Every box caught a non-answer on Route 104, and Brawly's named answers Salandit, Combee (Vespiquen) and Yanma are all in that table.
